dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, clear, white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark blue-gray wing body.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, well-defined white-to-light-gray boundaries along the outer webs of the folded primary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, yellowish-white, roughly triangular patch is visible on the posterior nape, bounded by the black crown and greenish-yellow mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, high-contrast linear boundary separates the black plumage of the crown from the greenish-yellow plumage of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white auricular patch bordered by a sharp black hood and ventral bib.
